thread:
Maria Chen: FYI FinCorp's security lead just asked for our latest external assessment artifacts (pen test + vuln scan) and a remediation timeline they can include in their vendor review. They want evidence by EOD next Wed. @Ana Gomez can we share the full pen test report or do we need redactions?
Ana Gomez: We can share the report with redactions for internal-only findings and customer-specific IP. High/critical vuln details are OK to share; redact internal hostnames and any customer-provided data. I'll confirm the exact sections.
Sam Patel: I'll coordinate delivery. Plan: create a sanitized bundle, upload to s3 (pre-signed link), and open a short read-only Confluence for mapping to SIG/CAIQ controls. Need owners for each remediation item.
Josh Li: Scan artifacts (Nessus + trivy) are in s3://redwood-sec/prod-assessments/fincorp-2026-03-18/ — raw JSON + consolidated CSV. Access logged via CloudTrail.
Ravi Kumar: Note: anything mentioning PII must be redacted before sharing — SOC policy. Also, for the pen test we flagged CVE-2024-3175 as high (app server lib). We have a vendor patch scheduled next week.
Maria Chen: @Casey Nguyen any legal gotchas? Customer asked whether we can sign a short addendum to include limited-scope sharing w/ their 3rd-party reviewers.
Casey Nguyen: We can provide a mutual NDA addendum (1 pager). No export controls. We should not share raw exploit scripts. Also require S3 pre-signed link expiry <= 14 days.
deploy-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-sec/sanitized/fincorp-2026-03-18/sanitized-bundle.zip (presigned link sent to thread via DM) :white_check_mark:
Sam Patel: Proposed remediation timeline (draft):
- High (CVE-2024-3175): owner @Josh Li, target 2026-04-02
- Medium (multiple deps): owner @Ravi Kumar, target 2026-04-09
- Low (informational): owner @Ana Gomez, target 2026-04-23
I'll convert to JIRA tickets and share IDs.
Ana Gomez: I'll prepare a CAIQ mapping doc that links each finding to SIG/CAIQ control IDs and evidence artifacts. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Maria Chen: Customer asked for a short walkthrough call with our security eng + product. Can we do Thurs 10am PT?
Josh Li: I can make Thurs 10am PT. I'll bring the remediation plan and patch timeline.
Ravi Kumar: I'll join for the SOC controls/Q&A.
Casey Nguyen: I'll be on the call for any contract clarification.
Sam Patel: Action items:
- @Ana finalize redaction checklist + CAIQ mapping (due tomorrow EOD)
- @Josh push high fix to staging and post proof-of-fix artifacts to JIRA (due 2026-04-02)
- @Ravi redact PII from artifacts and verify access logs (due 2026-03-22)
- @Casey produce NDA addendum (due 2026-03-21)
- @Maria send calendar invite to FinCorp w/ read-only link and Confluence doc (immediately)
Maria Chen: I've sent the invite and linked the sanitized bundle + CAIQ draft page. FinCorp confirmed Thurs 10am PT. They asked for SLA on remediation for Highs — can we commit to the 2026-04-02 date?
Josh Li: Yes, that is our internal target. If anything blocks, we'll escalate to infra.
Ravi Kumar: I'll validate that the vulnerability is only in a non-customer-data path; will flag if any scope change.
Casey Nguyen: Legal okayed 14-day link expiry and 1-pager NDA addendum. Share final link and I'll route the addendum.
Maria Chen: Great. I'll update the customer with the timeline and attach the NDA addendum once Casey posts it. Thanks team :pray:
Sam Patel: I'll create the JIRA epic + tickets now and paste the IDs here when ready.
Sam Patel: JIRA epic RW-SEC-1247 created. Tickets: RW-SEC-1248 (high), RW-SEC-1249 (medium). Links in Confluence.
Ana Gomez: CAIQ mapping draft posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/FinCorp+CAIQ+mapping — includes links to sanitized bundle and ticket references.
Maria Chen: Filing complete for the thread. If anything changes, reply here.
FinCorp (external): thanks — appreciated the quick turnaround. We'll review the bundle and bring questions to Thurs call.
